title: Among the patients who were diagnosed with SLE, who is the oldest with norm
question:
Among the patients who were diagnosed with SLE, who is the oldest with normal hemoglobin level. Provide the ID and sex.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: diagnosed with SLE refers to Diagnosis = 'SLE'; The larger the birthday value, the younger the person is, and vice versa; normal hemoglobin level refers to 10 < HGB < 17;

prediction.sql:
SELECT p.XCL_058, p.XCL_059
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.XCL_014 = p.XCL_058
WHERE p.XCL_064 = 'SLE'
  AND l.XCL_032 > 10
  AND l.XCL_032 < 17
ORDER BY p.XCL_060 ASC
LIMIT 1;
